description: This file implements a store for managing temporary posts in a Mattermost server, including functions to save, retrieve, delete, and list expired temporary posts, with database interactions and JSON handling.

classes.name: SqlTemporaryPostStore
classes.description: A store for handling temporary posts, providing methods for CRUD operations and querying expired posts.

methods.name: newSqlTemporaryPostStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlTemporaryPostStore instance.

methods.name: InvalidateTemporaryPost
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to invalidate a temporary post (currently empty).

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a temporary post to the database, with validation and transaction handling.

methods.name: saveT
methods.description: Internal method to insert or update a temporary post within a transaction.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a temporary post by ID, parsing JSON fields as needed.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a temporary post by ID.

methods.name: GetExpiredPosts
